create_distrax_from_tfp: create a Distrax distribution wrapper from a TFP distribution using distribution_from_tfp
sample_from_wrapped_distribution: sample random values from a TFP distribution wrapped with distribution_from_tfp
compute_log_prob_wrapped: compute the log probability of a value using a TFP distribution wrapped in Distrax
compute_kl_divergence_wrapped: compute KL divergence between two distributions using the wrapped distribution_from_tfp API
get_distribution_stats_wrapped: get mean, variance, stddev, entropy, and mode from a TFP distribution wrapped in Distrax
